newsitem.title: USA: D'Amato to support Cuomo for U.S. Housing Secy.
newsitem.headline: D'Amato to support Cuomo for U.S. Housing Secy.

text.p: Senate Banking Committee Chairman Alfonse D'Amato, R-NY, said Friday he would support Andrew Cuomo's nomination for Housing Secretary.
President Clinton nominated Cuomo, the son of former New York Governor Mario Cuomo, to replace Henry Cisneros who is leaving the post.
Cuomo's nomination must go before the Senate Banking Committee before it is forwarded to the full Senate.
"I've worked with Andrew Cuomo and he'll make a fine Secretary, I intend to support his nomination," D'Amato said in a statement.

Sen. Lauch Faircloth, a Republican from North Carolina who chaired the Banking Committee's subcommittee on the Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD), said he would scrutinize Cuomo's nomination.
"The last thing HUD needs is a Big City liberal at its helm. I will closely scrutinize his nomination," Faircloth said in a statement.
